SOC2.title: Logical and Physical Access Controls
SOC2.description: Controls restrict logical and physical access to systems, data, and facilities.

SOC2.title: System Operations and Monitoring
SOC2.description: Controls monitor system components, detect anomalies, and respond to security events.

SOC2.title: Change Management
SOC2.description: Controls authorize, test, approve, and track system changes.

SOC2.title: Availability
SOC2.description: Controls support availability commitments through backups, recovery, and resilience.

ISO27001.title: Information Security Policies
ISO27001.description: Management direction and support for information security are defined and reviewed.

ISO27001.title: Asset Management
ISO27001.description: Information assets are identified, classified, and handled according to risk.

ISO27001.title: Access Control
ISO27001.description: Access to information and systems is limited according to business requirements.

ISO27001.title: Operations Security
ISO27001.description: Operational procedures protect systems from malware, logging gaps, and vulnerabilities.

GDPR.title: Processor Obligations
GDPR.description: Processors provide sufficient guarantees and process personal data under controller instructions.

GDPR.title: Security of Processing
GDPR.description: Appropriate technical and organizational measures protect personal data.

GDPR.title: Breach Notification
GDPR.description: Personal data breaches are notified to supervisory authorities without undue delay.
